summary: All modules shipped with Ansible are new-style (Python or PowerShell), with arguments embedded in the module, unlike old-style modules that need a separate args file and an extra connection.
questions: Why are old-style modules less efficient?

answer_card.title: New-style modules
answer_card.answer_md: All shipped modules are new-style (Python or PowerShell). New-style modules have their arguments **embedded**; old-style ones need a separate file copied over, requiring two connections instead of one.
